comment: chi 5.3 on Go 1.27, one function per family registering its routes in the implementation package under Implementation/, and the server's main package in Implementation/cmd/server. The suite is UnitTests/, go test over the router served by net/http/httptest, and never reaches the image. chi is a router over net/http and binds nothing, so bodies and answers go through go-chi/render, which chi's README names among its subpackages. render.Bind decodes a body and calls the payload's Bind, where go-playground's validator runs, and a refusal is the ErrResponse of chi's REST example, which render's README points to. The first-error route is wired by hand, because go-playground cannot stop at the first failure. The lockfile is go.mod, which records every module version the build selects, and go.sum, which holds their hashes. upgrade is go get -u ./..., which moves every module to its newest release within its major version.

noHandler.cors.preflight: go-chi/cors among the /cors subrouter's middlewares answers the preflight before the subrouter routes it.
noHandler.errors.unmatched: chi's router answers a path no route matches with net/http's NotFound, a 404 with a text body.
noHandler.errors.wrong_method: chi's router answers a method the path has no route for with 405, and an Allow header naming the methods it has.

authorized.mechanism: A middleware on the route, through r.With, that compares the bearer token and refuses any other with http.Error and 403, as chi's README writes its AdminOnly middleware

baseline.builtin: render.PlainText writes the text as text/plain.

body.mechanism: render.Bind decodes the order by its Content-Type and calls its Bind method, which on the validate routes runs go-playground's validator over the validate tags. The first-error route runs the same validator over one field at a time, because go-playground cannot stop at the first failure

cache.mechanism: go-chi/stampede in front of each cache route through r.With. It runs the handler once for a key and keeps the answer, headers included, in one goware/cachestore-mem store for the process, keyed by the path and the route's vary headers

compressed.mechanism: chi's Compress middleware on the two /compressed routes through r.With, at gzip's fastest level

cors.mechanism: go-chi/cors among the /cors subrouter's middlewares, which run before the subrouter routes, so a preflight needs no OPTIONS route

errors.builtin: chi's router answers a miss with net/http's 404 text, and a method a path lacks with 405. A body render cannot decode is refused with 400 and the example's ErrResponse, and the items handlers render its ErrNotFound for a missing row.

etag.mechanism: A middleware on the /etag routes, through r.With, that holds back the body, hashes it with SHA-1 and answers a matching If-None-Match with 304

forms.builtin: net/http's ParseForm and FormFile read the two bodies, and the form's numbers are converted with strconv.

headers.builtin: The three headers are read from net/http's header map, the account converted with strconv.

items.builtin: One route per method on /items/{id}, the id read with chi.URLParam. GET and HEAD share a handler, because chi answers HEAD only where a route names it.

json.builtin: render.JSON encodes the payload with encoding/json into a buffer and writes the buffer.

middleware.mechanism: No-op func(http.Handler) http.Handler layers that r.With wraps around the handler, four or sixteen of them

parameters.builtin: chi.URLParam reads each capture as a string, which strconv converts.

query.builtin: net/http parses the query string, and strconv converts the numbers.

sse.builtin: Written by hand, because chi has no event stream and render's gives every event the type data. Each row is one event, flushed through net/http's ResponseController.

static.builtin: A wildcard route hands each file to net/http's FileServer, as chi's fileserver example does.

stream.builtin: encoding/json's encoder writes each row and its newline, flushed through net/http's ResponseController.

template.mechanism: html/template, embedded in the binary and parsed once, executed into the response by the handler, because chi has no view layer
